title: The Scholar-Priest and the Paradox of Service: Jozsef Sutak's Role in the Hungarian Mathematical Golden Age
summary: This paper re-evaluates Jozsef Sutak (1865-1954), a Hungarian scholar-priest and professor, as a grey eminence rather than a genius, offering a counter-narrative to the history of Hungarian university mathematics. By examining his career - including his 1897 Bolyai translation and his defense of set theory during the 1911 Grundlagenkrise - the study illuminates the overlooked substructure of the academic system.
